title: [Fix] Remove BuildResidualListOMP per-point mutex, fix VIO UB/OOB/leak, and fix UndistortPcl loop
body:
## Summary Pure-C++ concurrency, memory-safety, UB, and heap-leak fixes across 4 source files (`+137 / -45` lines). No public headers (`include/*.h`), ROS topics/parameters, `CMakeLists.txt`, or default config/logging behaviors are modified. | # | Commit | File(s) | Fix | Output Impact | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | `25a774f` `[Enh]` | `src/voxel_map.cpp` | Replace `vector` with `uint8_t` to remove per-point mutex in `BuildResidualListOMP`; value-init `PointToPlane single_ptpl{}` (fixes UBSan invalid-`bool` load) | **Bit-exact identical** | | 2 | `507d29e` `[Fix]` | `src/visual_point.cpp`, `src/vio.cpp` | Fix 256 B/pt/frame heap leak in `updateVisualMapPoints`, null/uninitialized pointer checks (`VisualPoint::ref_patch`, `precomputeReferencePatches`, `retrieveFromVisualSparseMap`), `G.setZero()`, and `updateStateInverse` `solution` cleanup | **Preserves valid paths** | | 3 | `6dae34d` `[Fix]` | `src/vio.cpp` | Fix uninitialized `ref_mean`/`other_mean` and cross-pair NCC accumulation in `updateReferencePatch`; fix image-border OOB reads (`isPatchInBounds` / `isRefPatchValid`) and `n_meas == 0` guard | **Changes corrupted outputs** | | 4 | `b3dd11f` `[Fix]` | `src/IMU_Processing.cpp` | Break outer `IMUpose` loop in `UndistortPcl` once `points.begin()` is reached (prevents repeated motion compensation of `points[0]`) | **Fixes `points[0]` multi-pass bug** | *Each commit is self-contained and can be cherry-picked independently; happy to split into separate PRs if preferred.* **Verification headline (`ros:noetic-ros-base`, `aarch64`, GCC 9.4.0):** - **Build & `-Wall`**: `fastlivo_mapping` builds cleanly; across the 4 modified files, `-Wall` warnings drop from **90 → 88** (**0 new**, eliminating both `-Wmaybe-uninitialized` warnings on `ref_mean`/`other_mean`). - **Linked real-source strict ASan + UBSan + LSan (`halt_on_error=1`)**: **9/9 test cases fail on `main` (`0d2c034`) → 0/9 fail on PR `HEAD` (`b3dd11f`)**, with **0 diff** across 745 `BuildResidualListOMP` residuals under 4 OpenMP threads. - *Scope note: All builds and real-source unit/repro drivers ran on `linux/arm64` (`aarch64`); full end-to-end ROS 1 rosbag ATE evaluation and `x86_64` builds were not run.* ---
Detailed Root Causes & Changes (by commit) ### Commit 1 (`25a774f`): `BuildResidualListOMP` lock removal & `PointToPlane` init (`src/voxel_map.cpp`) - **Per-point mutex**: Every `#pragma omp parallel for` iteration acquired a per-call `std::mutex mylock` to write `useful_ptpl[i]` and `all_ptpl_list[i]`. Replacing bit-packed `std::vector` with `std::vector(pv_list.size(), 0)` lets each thread write exclusively to index `i` (`useful_ptpl[i]`, `all_ptpl_list[i]`, `pv_list[i].normal`) while `voxel_map_` / octrees remain read-only. Results are still appended sequentially in `i = 0 .. N-1` order. - **Uninitialized `bool` UB**: Stack-local `PointToPlane single_ptpl;` left unused scalar members (including `bool is_valid_`) uninitialized; copying `all_ptpl_list[i] = single_ptpl;` triggered UBSan (`load of value ..., not a valid value for type 'bool'`). Value-initialized `PointToPlane single_ptpl{};` without touching `include/voxel_map.h`. ### Commit 2 (`507d29e`): VIO heap leak, null/uninitialized pointers, and stale `G` (`src/visual_point.cpp`, `src/vio.cpp`) - **`updateVisualMapPoints`**: Moved `new float[patch_size_total]` (256 B for 8×8) and `getImagePatch()` inside `if (add_flag)` (previously leaked whenever `add_flag == false`). - **`VisualPoint::VisualPoint`**: Initialized `ref_patch(nullptr)` so `deleteFeatureRef()` and `precomputeReferencePatches()` never read an uninitialized member pointer. - **`precomputeReferencePatches`**: Checked `pt == nullptr || pt->ref_patch == nullptr` and `img.empty()` before dereferencing `pt->ref_patch->img_`. - **`retrieveFromVisualSparseMap`**: Initialized `Feature *ref_ftr = nullptr`, added `if (count == 0) continue;` before `phtometric_errors / count`, and guarded against null `ref_ftr`. - **`computeJacobianAndUpdateEKF`**: Added `G.setZero()` before the pyramid loop so `state->cov -= G * state->cov` cannot reuse a stale or uninitialized `G` when all levels exit early. - **`updateStateInverse`**: Materialized `solution` as `MD(DIM_STATE, 1)` instead of `auto` (matching `updateState`). ### Commit 3 (`6dae34d`): VIO uninitialized means, unreset NCC, and OOB image reads (`src/vio.cpp`) - **`updateReferencePatch`**: - `ref_mean` and `other_mean` were uninitialized locals only assigned when `abs(feat->mean_) < 1e-6` (flagged by GCC `-Wall` as `-Wmaybe-uninitialized`). Since the inner loop of the first outer iteration caches `mean_` for all other observations, every outer iteration from the 2nd onward read uninitialized stack garbage. Initialized both from cached `mean_` (keeping the original `double` `0.0` accumulator in `std::accumulate`). - Moved `NCC_up`, `NCC_down1`, `NCC_down2` inside the inner `itm` loop to fix what appears to be unintended cross-pair accumulation, and guarded `sqrt(NCC_down1 * NCC_down2) > 1e-6f` and `count > 0` against `0/0` (`NaN`). - **Image-border OOB reads (`updateState`, `updateStateInverse`, `precomputeReferencePatches`, `updateVisualMapPoints`)**: - `border = (patch_size_half + 1) * (1 << patch_pyrimid_level)`, whereas `updateState` reaches `pyramid_level = (patch_pyrimid_level - 1) + search_level` (`search_level` up to `2`), requiring **double `border`**: `160 px` vs. `border = 80 px` under `avia.yaml` / `HILTI22.yaml` / `MARS_LVIG.yaml` (`patch_pyrimid_level: 4`), and `80 px` vs. `border = 40 px` under `NTU_VIRAL.yaml` / defaults (`patch_pyrimid_level: 3`). On normal `cv::Mat` buffers, this ~30–60 KB read before `img.data` can skip heap redzones and silently consume garbage pixels; against guard pages it faults immediately. - Added file-local helpers `isPatchInBounds(...)` and `isRefPatchValid(...)` enforcing exact bilinear (`[0, +scale]`) and central-difference (`[-scale, +2*scale]`) pixel bounds, `pf[2] <= 0`, and `[0, width) x [0, height)` range checks before `floorf`->`int`. - Shared `isRefPatchValid(...)` between `precomputeReferencePatches` and `updateStateInverse` so both skip identical invalid points; reset `z.setZero(); H_sub.setZero();` each iteration and restore `old_state` + `break` when `n_meas == 0`. ### Commit 4 (`b3dd11f`): `ImuProcess::UndistortPcl` loop termination (`src/IMU_Processing.cpp`) - `if (it_pcl == pcl_wait_proc.points.begin()) break;` exited only the inner loop while the outer `IMUpose` loop continued stepping backward. Whenever `points[0].curvature / 1000.0 > IMUpose[1].offset_time` (e.g., after blind-range / `point_filter_num` culling or scan splitting), `points[0]` was motion-compensated repeatedly on every earlier IMU interval. Added `bool all_done = false;` to exit both loops.
Verification Details (Comparative -Wall, 9 Real-Source ASan/UBSan/LSan Cases & Standalone Bounds Oracle) ### 1. ROS 1 Noetic Build & Comparative `-Wall` Check (`aarch64`) - Environment: `ros:noetic-ros-base` (Ubuntu 20.04 `aarch64`, GCC 9.4.0, `-DMP_EN -DMP_PROC_NUM=4`, Sophus `a621ff`, `rpg_vikit`, Eigen 3.3.7, OpenCV 4.2.0, PCL 1.10). - `catkin_make -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-Wall"` built and linked `fastlivo_mapping` with 0 errors. - Compiling all 4 modified `.cpp` files with `g++ -std=c++17 -O3 -Wall -fopenmp -DMP_EN -DMP_PROC_NUM=4` (`origin/main` `0d2c034` vs. PR `HEAD` `b3dd11f`): **90 → 88** warning lines, **0 new**, **2 eliminated** (`ref_mean` and `other_mean` `-Wmaybe-uninitialized` in `src/vio.cpp`). ### 2. Linked Real-Source Strict ASan + UBSan + LSan Suite (`halt_on_error=1`) Compiled directly against `src/vio.cpp`, `src/frame.cpp`, `src/visual_point.cpp`, `src/voxel_map.cpp`, and `src/IMU_Processing.cpp` with `-std=c++17 -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fopenmp -DMP_EN -DMP_PROC_NUM=4` and run with `ASAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1` and `UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1` (`detect_leaks=1` + `leak:libtbb.so` suppression on the leak case): | Test Case (Real Source) | Upstream `0d2c034` (`9/9` failed) | PR `HEAD` `b3dd11f` (`0/9` failed) | |---|---|---| | **In-border OOB (`lvl=3`, `border=40`, `px=(320,45)`, `level=2, search_level=2`, `PROT_NONE` guard pages)** | `ASan: SEGV` (READ) at `src/vio.cpp:1602` | **PASS** (0 errors, exit `0`) | | **In-border OOB (`lvl=4`, `avia.yaml` `border=80`, `px=(320,85)`, `level=3, search_level=2`, `PROT_NONE` guard pages)** | `ASan: SEGV` (READ) at `src/vio.cpp:1602` | **PASS** (0 errors, exit `0`) | | **Inverse-comp `nullptr` + stale `G` (`computeJacobianAndUpdateEKF`)** | `UBSan` null member access at `src/vio.cpp:1346` | **PASS** (skipped, `\|\|cov_after - cov_before\|\| = 0.000000000`) | | **Inverse-comp OOB ref patch + consistent skip (`precomputeReferencePatches` + `updateStateInverse`)** | `ASan: SEGV` (READ) at `src/vio.cpp:1376` | **PASS** (`pt0` updated `err0=5377.57`; OOB `pt1` skipped, sentinel `999.00` untouched) | | **`retrieveFromVisualSparseMap` duplicate-id `count == 0` guard** | `ASan: heap-use-after-free` at `src/vio.cpp:741` | **PASS** (duplicate-id skipped, valid point retrieved, `total_points=1`) | | **`updateVisualMapPoints` heap leak (10 unchanged points, LSan)** | `LSan: Direct leak of 2560 B in 10 objects` at `src/vio.cpp:927` | **PASS** (`0` bytes leaked from `FAST-LIVO2`) | | **`updateReferencePatch` NCC (6 non-constant orthogonal 8×8 ramps) + constant-patch check** | `id=6`: `1.972000` (exact `1.0`); `id=1..5`: `1.987213` (exact `1.8`); constant: `nan` | **PASS** (`id=6`: `1.000000`, `id=1..5`: `1.800000`; constant finite `1.000000`) | | **`ImuProcess::UndistortPcl` (`pt[0]` 25 ms > `IMUpose[1]` 5 ms, `wz=2.0 rad/s`, 50 ms scan)** | `pt[0]` compensated 4×: pos error `1.498594e-1` | **PASS** (`pt[0]` pos error `9.024778e-9`, matching `Rz(-0.05) * (1,0,0)`) | | **`VoxelMapManager::BuildResidualListOMP` (4 OpenMP threads, 400 map / 800 query → 745 residuals)** | `UBSan: load of value 128 ... not a valid value for type 'bool'` (`voxel_map.h:54`) | **PASS** (0 ASan/UBSan errors; `diff -u` empty: **bit-exact identical** across 745 residuals) | ### 3. Standalone Model Verification (`isPatchInBounds`) - An unlinked standalone C++ oracle test (`clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror`) exhaustively verified the `isPatchInBounds` formula against every pixel offset accessed by bilinear and central-difference loops across **6,787,380** `(width, height, patch_size, scale, with_grad, u, v)` combinations including subpixel borders, `NaN`/`Inf`, and overflow inputs (**0 off-by-one discrepancies**).
